# Green Bay SHRM

> Green Bay SHRM is a local chapter of the Society for Human Resource Management serving HR professionals in the Green Bay and Wisconsin region with certification support, networking events, job opportunities, and professional development.

The chapter provides members with access to SHRM-CP and SHRM-SCP certification study groups, monthly networking events, a job board featuring positions at major employers like Schneider, and initiatives focused on workplace diversity, equity, and inclusion. Green Bay SHRM connects HR professionals through a members-only portal powered by Wild Apricot.

## Key Topics

- SHRM Certification (SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP)
- Professional Development
- HR Job Board
- Membership & Networking
- Diversity & Inclusion
- Study Groups
- HR Compliance
- Learning & Development
- Compensation Analysis
- Green Bay HR Community
- Wisconsin HR Professionals
- Hybrid Work
- Member Directory
- Chapter Leadership
- Recruitment Strategy

- [Home Page](https://gbshrm.org): Green Bay SHRM local chapter homepage with membership, events, and networking info

- [Events](https://gbshrm.org/events): Green Bay SHRM events listing including certification study groups and professional development

- [You Can't Make This Up... HR Edition](https://gbshrm.org/event-6599684): April 2026 interactive HR networking workshop at Ahnapee Brewery
- [HR Professionals as Meteorologists: Understanding Weather and Climate for Hiring Practices](https://gbshrm.org/event-6411387): April 2026 speaker event on hiring practices and recruitment strategy
